title: Tensor formula for the right adjoint of a perfect proper immersion
statement: Let i:Z\to Y be a closed immersion of Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme] that is proper and perfect, where perfect means i_*\mathcal O_Z is locally perfect over Y [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Let c be a right adjoint to Ri_* on quasi-coherent derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], and K a quasi-coherent complex on Y. The canonical comparison morphism Li^*K\mathbin{\otimes^L}c(\mathcal O_Y)\to c(K), defined as the mate under Ri_*\dashv c of the projection-formula morphism Ri_*(Li^*K\mathbin{\otimes^L}c(\mathcal O_Y))\to K, is an isomorphism; equivalently c(K)\cong Li^*K\mathbin{\otimes^L}c(\mathcal O_Y).

source.place: Tag 0A9U (projection formula for a perfect proper morphism and its right adjoint)

proof.text: Obtain finite Tor bounds from the perfect immersion hypothesis. Apply the existing perfect tensor formula case and direct-sum case to the supplied adjunction c. Extract hRf, hO, tensor closure, the supplied monoidal pullback structure and its adjunction.

Use the existing global right-adjoint tensor natural transformation τ. Its pinned inverse equations show that IsIso(τ_K) is equivalent to the original tensorFormulaComparisonProperty, so generation will prove precisely that original predicate. Equip the two functors with separate exact shift structures.

Both source and target functors preserve u-sized coproducts: use quasi-coherent ambient coproduct closure, pullback left adjointness, tensorRight coproduct preservation, and the already supplied direct-sum preservation for c.

Use Q(K)=∀n,IsIso(τ_(K[n])). Perfect objects stay perfect under shifts and isomorphisms, so the perfect case proves Q on generators. Apply the proved shift-saturated perfect localizing closure lemma and derivedQCohPerfectGeneration. Transport n=0 along shiftFunctorZero and recover the original tensorFormulaComparisonProperty using its equivalence with the isomorphism locus.
